messages:
alex: heads up  apiserver 503 spike in eu-central-1 starting ~07:10. controller-manager leader flapping and attach storms from GPU onboarding.
maria: seeing same on dashboards  apiserver error-rate x7, p50 latency ~2x, etcd follower_lag on two followers.
sam: looks correlated with the onboarding batch job kicking off. it's trying to attach a large set of nodes concurrently.
jin: controller-manager logs show lease renewal timeouts and repeated leader handoffs:
```
I0210 07:11:05.123456 1 leaderelection.go:274] failed to renew lease: timed out waiting for the condition
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer deref
```
maria: also noticing conntrack table exhaustion on the NATs  SNAT translations spike during mass attaches, causing TCP resets to apiserver.
alex: attach flow outline: pod create -> device-plugin -> kubelet -> attach. simultaneous attaches cause kubelet churn and controller loops to backfill endpoints, exacerbating leader churn.
sam: the onboarding producer is processing ~300 GPU attach ops across 10m. We recently increased reserved buffer which let many attaches run at once.
jin: etcd metrics: leader_proposals_overloaded increased, db.total_slow_writes rising. NVMe write stall traces on two controlplane hosts at ~07:12.
maria: note on costs  current reserved buffer policy is ~$45k/mo in unused GPUs in euc1. Ops vs cost tradeoff needs a follow-up.
alex: short-term mitigations proposed:
- throttle onboarding/attach producer to 10 GPUs/min in eu-central-1
- temporarily increase controller-manager leaseDuration to 30s on canary masters
- tune kube-proxy conntrack_max and bump NAT gateway capacity
- add a short cooldown to autoscaler to avoid attach waves
sam: suggestion: pause the onboarding queue for 5m and observe apiserver error-rate. I can rate-limit the producer in 3m.
jin: I'll patch the controller-manager flag for leaseDuration=30s on two masters (canary), and add extra leader-election logging.
deploy-bot: controller-manager canary rollout started on masters m-a and m-b
deploy-bot: patch applied: --leader-elect-lease-duration=30s (canary)
alex: after pausing the queue apiserver 503s fell ~80% within 4m; leader flips decreased and etcd write latencies improved.
maria: NVMe stalls cleared on the affected controlplane nodes; conntrack reclamation observed after NAT scale.
sam: plan: implement throttling on attach producer (sam), add exponential backoff in attach controller (jin), infra to re-evaluate reserved buffer policy (maria).
alex: filed incident and started postmortem timeline. thanks all :thumbsup: 
maria: follow-up idea  prototype a serializing attach-controlplane agent to funnel high-risk attaches and reduce controlplane pressure. will spike next week.
